thread:
Casey: heads-up: Customer Meridian is pushing for an EoQ private deployment. they want SLA 99.9% + p95 <150ms for chat. asks include dedicated pool, KMS/HSM, 1yr audit retention, and a safe canary path. need cross-team plan. who can map constraints?

Irene: i can draft the SLO appendix and the contract gating checklist. quick Q: will Meridian accept a short onboarding window with relaxed latency? that changes risk.

Casey: Meridian agreed to a 48h onboarding window where they accept up to 300ms p95 for bulk imports. outside that window they expect full SLA.

Omar: runtime notes: steady qps ~110, spikes up to 500 for <10min. median prompt ~160 tokens, 99th ~950. for p95 we need careful batching + kv-prefetch. prewarm requirement?

Ben: infra: we can do dedicated pool in their VPC. tradeoffs: prewarm nodes vs fast autoscale. if runtime needs <15s cold-start we'll do prewarm; otherwise standby capacity. will run cost delta.

Sofia: security: KMS + optional HSM, VPC peering, SSO via SAML/SCIM. 1yr retention flagged by legal — they want PII redaction plan. also threat model before private control-plane access.

Omar: initial perf math: baseline quantized model with 8xA100-equivalent hits median; p95 needs autoscale + ~40s scale-up or prewarm. i'll prototype continuous-batching window sizes and kv cache prefetch this week.

Irene: proposed rollout timeline (high level):
- Contract gating: privacy addendum + SLO appendix signed
- Staging validation: perf + security checklist (10 days)
- Canary: 5% -> 20% over 72h with strict rollback triggers
- Full ramp after 7d stable metrics

Ben: infra action items:
- cost delta prewarm vs standby by Wed EOD
- reserve staging cluster "meridian-stg-1758" (4 prewarm slots) - pending billing approval
- automation: rapid attach for standby nodes (P1)

Sofia: security action items:
- KMS integration design (owner: Sofia)
- PII/log redaction plan for legal (owner: Sofia + Legal)
- threat model + mitigation doc by next Tue

Omar: runtime action items:
- perf matrix + test harness (deliverable: perf-matrix.md)
- define prewarm SLA required from infra (e.g., <10s cold-start)
- fallback behavior for heavy tails (documented and tested)

Casey: owners recap: Irene (product), Omar (runtime), Ben (infra), Sofia (security). Meridian PM = Casey.

ops-bot: staging cluster "meridian-stg-1758" created by Ben at 2024-11-18T11:05:12Z  4 prewarm slots allocated.

Irene: can each owner drop a 3-bullet checklist by EOD tomorrow? i'll stitch into the gating doc and share with Meridian.

Omar: will post perf matrix tonight. quick hypothesis: 8 GPUs + continuous batching + 60ms kv-prefetch meets steady; bursts require autoscale tuning and a small prewarm buffer.

Ben: noted. i'll include automated scale attach times in the cost delta and propose a fallback pool sizing.

Sofia: pinging legal: @legal need guidance on 1yr retention for finance customer Meridian and any prescriptive redaction requirements.

Casey: thanks — we'll triage blockers in the 15-min sync tomorrow if owners post checklists. otherwise i'll consolidate and send to Meridian legal. :handshake:
